# Victoire Vidal — Private Guide in Paris

> Victoire Vidal is a born-and-raised Parisian private guide. She designs and personally leads bespoke cultural walks in Paris, in English or French, for private parties of up to six guests. Each walk is a starting point that is adapted to the guests' interests and pace.

## Private walks

- [Elegant Paris — How Paris Invented the Art of Living](https://victoirevidal.com/elegant-paris.html): the Paris of kings, financiers and opera-goers, between the Louvre and the Opéra. About 3 hours.
- [Hidden Paris — The City Behind the Façades](https://victoirevidal.com/hidden-paris.html): covered passages, hidden courtyards and the Paris of merchants, makers and markets, between the Palais-Royal and Les Halles. About 3½ hours.
- [Paris Through Local Eyes — The Beauty Hidden in Everyday Life](https://victoirevidal.com/paris-through-local-eyes.html): a slow morning walk about everyday Parisian life, architecture and neighbourhood habits. About 3 hours.
- [Paris under Occupation — The Day the City Lost Its Freedom](https://victoirevidal.com/paris-under-occupation.html): the history of Paris from 1940 to 1944 told through the lives of ordinary Parisians. About 3 hours.
- [La Nouvelle Athènes — Hidden Courtyards & the Artists' Quarter](https://victoirevidal.com/la-nouvelle-athenes.html): the artists' quarter just below Montmartre, its carriage gates and hidden courtyards. Half a day.
